status: SEASON GAME DEPTH CHART, the released 2014 game input. Issued by Stone on August 30, 2014 at the reduction to 53 (Document 3 row 9) from the August 28 personnel packet's baseline, over the 53 only; the secondary re-set September 13, 2014 for Week 2 after the September 8 transactions (Harris and Lowery to reserve/injured, Ball signed, Phillips promoted); the order unchanged and the inactives re-set September 20, 2014 for Week 3; the defensive-back order and the inactives re-set September 27, 2014 for Week 4 after the San Diego preparation (Bouye the nickel and Prosinski the sixth defensive back with Poyer and Butler on their holds and listed last); the receiver order, the defensive-back order, the nickel and outside-reserve seats and the inactives re-set October 4, 2014 for Week 5 after the Pittsburgh preparation (Adams X with Nicks fifth and the X relief only; Bouye the nickel, Ball the outside reserve, Butler released and inactive by decision, Poyer on his hold and listed last). Stone changes it only by decision; each change is logged in career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/depth_chart.md and copied here in the same commit.
effective: August 30, 2014, after Caldwell's reduction to 53 (4 p.m. ET); the defensive-back order set for Week 2 on September 13, 2014 and re-set for Week 4 on September 27, 2014; the receiver order, the defensive-back order and its two slot roles re-set for Week 5 on October 4, 2014, with game_day_inactives re-set for Week 5 the same day
sources: The August 28 personnel packet's season depth chart baseline (Regular-season Week 1.md: Adams X, Thielen H, Hawkins Z; Lewis, Kelce, Jensen; Monroe, Bitonio, Brewster, Turner, Johnson; Kreiter snapping; Hawkins returning kicks and punts with Hurns the second punt returner; Nicks back to X and Adams to Z only after medical clearance and a full practice week); the frozen August 27 Atlanta chart (Preseason_Games/Game_04/depth_chart.json) for every other order; the current roster for control and availability; the August 30 reduction (Roster_Decisions/final_roster_cuts.md) for the 53.
rule: Order within each kernel position group, first = starter, as the kernel reads it. The packet's baseline sets the starting eleven on offense, the snapper and the returners; the Atlanta chart's order is carried for everyone else, minus the players who left on August 30. A player out under a medical instruction is listed last in his group while out and is on the inactive list (Poyer, on his hold, is last among the defensive backs for Week 5; Butler, released October 2, is placed above him and is inactive by Stone's decision; Stone decided Nicks's X question on October 4: Adams starts X and Nicks is the fifth receiver and the X relief on prepared series only, not a starting promotion; Hoskins keeps the fourth tight-end place); a player on reserve/injured is off the chart; his return to the order is Stone's decision on clearance under the packet's condition. The roles field carries the kernel roles (passer, placekicker, punt, kick_return, punt_return) and, from Week 5, the two defensive-back seat roles kernel 2014.6 reads (nickel: Bouye; outside_reserve: Ball, the first corner to replace an outside starter), transcribed from Stone's Dime decision in the Week 5 packet; Hurns is the second punt returner by Stone's instruction and is not given the kernel role, which the kernel reads as the first returner.

captains.structure: Six captains, three on offense (quarterback, offensive line, skill group) and three on defense (defensive line, linebackers, secondary), named by Stone with no player vote
